scope: Independent published-claim/value and mandatory-condition review; source-only, no new drug quantities or numerical stage.
question: Do primary native EMC studies make an empirical venetoclax single-agent/combination claim that a source-compatible all-model/condition comparison could meaningfully challenge or extend?
models: USZ20-EMC1 full40 screen and selected validation
prior_exposure: Verified R1-R9 screens and qualitative decisions already exposed to team; this is not blinded. Prior BCL-family-comparison NO-GO concerned absent comparator compounds, not a blanket venetoclax empirical-response answer.
proposed_contribution_if_supported: A fixed source-compatible empirical claim about consistency or discordance of published venetoclax responses under matched conditions, changing which native models/conditions warrant a common controlled replication. Exact author claim must be authenticated before a quantitative proposal.
value_gate: Actual published claim must be narrower and meaningful, not an invented universal model claim.
All identifiable native source conditions and relevant aliases/donor reuse must remain accountable.
A numerical comparison needs matched endpoint/exposure/control or an explicitly assay-separated estimand that can answer the fixed question.
Published response figures already establishing the same conclusion are prior art, not new findings.
strongest_alternative: Culture medium, duration, dose coverage, ATP/metabolic readout, selected validation and heterogeneous screening endpoints can produce discordance without a BCL2-specific or clinical interpretation.
defeat: No scientifically meaningful source-compatible unanswered comparison
Already published and evaluated same empirical claim
Only unmatched drug labels or selected absence available
forbidden: New response values, gene values, statistics or graph digitization
Common IC50/clinical-exposure cutoffs across incompatible assays
Invented additivity metric without actual combination schema
Target dependency or clinical benefit inference
Network retrieval before an additional genuine route freeze
source_branch: Zero-copy retained primary Bangerter XML; extract numeric-masked relevant author qualitative claims and captions only. Broader owns dose/method/readout schema. NCC prior verified claims and schema reused initially; no new source route assumed.
ownership: Only this assigned subtree; lead owns shared state/main/push.
